titles: 一辉与史黛菈的同班同学

status.current: interrupts the closing ceremony to take a symbolic photo

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Classmate and subject of her final podium photo.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Classmate whom she directs to stand beside Ikki.

periods.summary: Kagami waits until the festival is about to close, then floods the arena with identical clones to evade security. She reaches the podium, orders Stella to stand beside Ikki on the champion step, and photographs the two together, giving the festival a final image that reflects their side-by-side path rather than only winner and runner-up positions.

key_events.summary: Uses clones to interrupt the ceremony and captures Ikki and Stella standing together.

status.condition: sentenced to remedial lessons after making a scene at the award ceremony

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Senior whose victory she celebrates and interviews.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Subject of an indecent photo that Stella destroys while demanding the data.

periods.summary: Kagami opens the victory party toast, joking that she has been assigned three days of remedial lessons for causing a scene at the award ceremony. She later spreads out photos from the Seven Stars Festival and discusses them with the guests. When she tries to reveal a compromising photo of Stella, Stella destroys it with a heated punch and forces Kagami to surrender the file.

key_events.summary: Leads the toast and shares tournament photos at Ikki's party.

periods.time: Invisible helicopter strike over the U.S. fleet
periods.label: 心象倍增支援舰队奇袭

status.current: withdraws from the fleet strike to support the coast after amplifying Kirihara's attacks
status.condition: combat-capable and impressed by the combined effect

relationships.shizuya-kirihara: Amplifies Kirihara's invisible arrows and needles his vanity and fearfulness.
relationships.shinguji-kurono: Helps transport Kurono to the enemy fleet.

periods.summary: Kagami is unusually assigned to a front-line special operation despite being D-rank because Itsuki recognizes that her multiplication ability can massively improve Kirihara's invisible arrow attacks. Riding in the invisible helicopter with Kirihara and Kurono, she uses Raiseup on Kirihara's Million Rain, turning shots into devastating cluster volleys that cripple U.S. carriers. Her commentary also reveals that Itsuki likely memorizes even new student abilities and can build efficient combinations from them.

key_events.summary: Uses Raiseup to multiply Kirihara's invisible arrows against the Pacific Fleet.

periods.label: 以心象倍增采访战争英雄

status.current: actively gathering material for a postwar Hagun wall-newspaper special

relationships.nagi-arisuin: Walks with him through the celebration while reporting.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Asks to interview her about the Vermillion war and Japan battle.
relationships.kurono-shinguji: Wants to interview her after she wakes because Kurono is the greatest hero of the Tokyo defense.

periods.summary: Kagami turns the Tokyo victory celebration into a reporting opportunity. Using Raise Up to multiply herself, she interviews soldiers, students, civilians and children across the city, planning a large summer special for the Hagun wall newspaper. She comforts Stella over the Vermillion crisis and asks to hear the story once Stella finds Ikki, showing both journalistic curiosity and personal concern.

key_events.summary: Reports across the celebration and reunites with Stella, Shizuku and Alice.

abilities: Raise Up / self-duplication for simultaneous interviews

status.condition: overworked from wall-newspaper digital special issues

personality.summary: Kagami remains lively and journalistically relentless, but the volume clarifies her motive: news should show people that others have survived pain and are walking toward tomorrow, giving readers hope and energy.

abilities_owned: clone-producing Noble Art used to help with reporting work

relationships.ikki-kurogane: Friend/source; she informs him of KOK, domestic league, Moroboshi and Amane news and receives his thanks.
relationships.stella-vermillion: Friend whose wedding she plans to photograph extensively.
relationships.hagun-students: Reports on the aftermath and future paths of student knights.

periods.summary: Kagami is at Ikki's bedside when he wakes after Stella's abduction and later can only pray as the rescue team departs. In October she meets Ikki during solitary training at Hagun. She has been exhausting herself producing digital wall-newspaper specials because disasters and recoveries have created many stories the public needs. She tells Ikki about his and Stella's A-class KOK qualification, Kurono's return to A-class, Nene's renewed training, Moroboshi's unexpected move to National Defense University, and Amane's likely return to Seven Stars competition. She states her journalism exists to show people who endured tragedy and still move forward, offering hope and courage.

key_events.summary: Witnesses Ikki's resolve and prays for the rescue team's safety.
Updates Ikki on postwar knight news and explains her journalism creed.
